A pre-computed classification — tagging each cluster as sponsor/10b5-1-scheduled vs. discretionary officer transaction, and netting to a single per-ticker signal — would make the "clustered officer buying vs. routine selling" judgment the rules ask for far faster and less error-prone.

Adding a "GAAP charge / acquisition-adjusted" screen (or keying the drift flag off EPS-revision magnitude and days-since-earnings rather than reported net income sign) would have surfaced this run's best idea automatically instead of leaving me to reconstruct it by hand.

Adding forward revenue-growth and EPS-revision (analyst estimate trend) fields per candidate would materially sharpen the "is this multiple deserved" call and reduce reliance on qualitative news vibes — the single biggest lever on proposal quality this run.
